name: novel-p0-build-isolated-snapshot-final-v2
argv: set -euo pipefail; novel_root=$(mktemp -d /tmp/novel-p0-isolated-build-v2.XXXXXX); novel_base=$(basename "$novel_root"); novel_snapshot="$novel_root/workspace"; novel_runtime="$novel_root/runtime"; mkdir -p "$novel_snapshot" "$novel_runtime/home" "$novel_runtime/tmp" "$novel_runtime/registry"; rsync -a src tests scripts package.json package-lock.json tsconfig*.json vitest.config.ts electron.vite.config.ts "$novel_snapshot/"; ln -s "$(pwd)/node_modules" "$novel_snapshot/node_modules"; novel_live_dist_before=$(find dist-mcp -type f -exec shasum -a 256 {} + | LC_ALL=C sort | shasum -a 256 | awk "{print \$1}"); novel_live_manifest_before=$(shasum -a 256 release-manifest.json | awk "{print \$1}"); (cd "$novel_snapshot" && env -u AI_CANVAS_MCP_ALLOW_MULTI -u AI_CANVAS_MCP_SINGLETON HOME="$novel_runtime/home" TMPDIR="$novel_runtime/tmp" AI_CANVAS_REGISTRY_PATH="$novel_runtime/registry/projects.json" AI_CANVAS_WORKSPACE="$novel_snapshot" AI_CANVAS_WRITE_LEASE_MODE=require npm run build); novel_snapshot_digest=$(jq -r .sourceDigest "$novel_snapshot/release-manifest.json"); novel_snapshot_build=$(jq -r .buildId "$novel_snapshot/release-manifest.json"); test "$novel_snapshot_digest" = "69865c673a6274552b7b018f3d2736efc0fc61409b786aba48835e3d9295d4e4"; test "$novel_snapshot_build" = "08b8f8168b32a84ef6ad515b00bd65fb"; novel_live_dist_after=$(find dist-mcp -type f -exec shasum -a 256 {} + | LC_ALL=C sort | shasum -a 256 | awk "{print \$1}"); novel_live_manifest_after=$(shasum -a 256 release-manifest.json | awk "{print \$1}"); test "$novel_live_dist_before" = "$novel_live_dist_after"; test "$novel_live_manifest_before" = "$novel_live_manifest_after"; kill -0 40383; kill -0 51269; novel_trash="/Users/hxx/.Trash/$novel_base"; test ! -e "$novel_trash"; mv "$novel_root" "$novel_trash"; printf "%s\n" "{\"buildCommand\":\"npm run build\",\"snapshotSourceDigest\":\"$novel_snapshot_digest\",\"snapshotBuildId\":\"$novel_snapshot_build\",\"liveDistAggregateBefore\":\"$novel_live_dist_before\",\"liveDistAggregateAfter\":\"$novel_live_dist_after\",\"liveReleaseManifestBefore\":\"$novel_live_manifest_before\",\"liveReleaseManifestAfter\":\"$novel_live_manifest_after\",\"activePidsAliveAfter\":[40383,51269],\"cleanup\":\"moved-recoverably-to-user-trash\",\"temporaryBasename\":\"$novel_base\"}"
